title: did_webvh in mimid-agent and mimid-server (hub enforce_did_webvh, agent identities, room identity by SCID)
description: mimi-mls supports did_webvh identities and the hub Observer can enforce the rules (ef2b7a1), tested at the mimi-mls level with two users, a hub Observer and revocation. Not yet wired into the products: mimid-agent creates BasicCredential identities from the user URI; mimid-server's hub never calls Observer::enforce_did_webvh; room policy and the participant list map members by BasicCredential identity, so a did_webvh member (identity = SCID) has no user URI. Needs: a code-points setting, agent storage of the device's DidWebvhCredential (Identity::load_did_webvh), a way for the controller to hand a device the new log, and the SCID-to-user mapping (draft §Reference Identifiers: pin the SCID per contact). Also: the protocol layer's own required_capabilities vs decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.16.
